svg.title: The louver queue
svg.desc: A long, shallow pergola follows the queue; fixed tilted slats target the afternoon sun.. Bus stop concept with perspective and accessible site plan.
svg.text: A long, shallow pergola follows the queue; fixed tilted slats target the afternoon sun.
Open gaps → no reliable rain cover.
KEEP CLEAR · continuous 1.8 m walking route
More of the queue fits under cover, but striped shade moves and slat gaps admit rain.
